name: Defined impact objective

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.32-4.38 — Sustainability Impact requires a specific, positive, real-world sustainability outcome objective)

summary: Tests whether the project has a named, specific positive sustainability impact objective — not a general 'ESG-friendly' framing but a particular environmental or social outcome the asset is intended to deliver. PS23/16 ¶4.32 requires the impact objective to be 'specific and measurable' and to address a sustainability challenge. PB methodology v3.5 aligned band requires the objective to be (a) named explicitly, (b) categorised against a recognised taxonomy of environmental or social outcomes (EU Taxonomy 6 objectives or equivalent), and (c) declared in deal-defining documentation (investment memorandum or equivalent).
